name: claude-code-mods
description: Small Claude Code mods: a last-turn summary status line, a cross-project notes pane, a running-sessions pane and a config map.

plugins.name: turn-pulse
plugins.description: A status line summarizing the last turn: duration, files edited, tool results, usage-limit cost. Optional band above the prompt.

plugins.name: notes
plugins.description: Save chat text with /note and review it in a side pane with done checkboxes.

plugins.name: sessions
plugins.description: A side pane listing the sessions running on this machine and their status.

plugins.name: config-map
plugins.description: A side pane mapping your CLAUDE.md blocks and settings keys, each unfolding to its content.
